description:
Look up an ERC-20 token on Base or Ethereum by contract address: name, symbol, decimals and total supply, read live from the chain. Use it to confirm what a contract address actually is before acting on it.

$0.002 USDC per call over x402. Failed calls cost nothing. Call without `payment` to get a quote.

payment.description: Base64 x402 payment payload. Omit it to receive a quote; sign that and call again.

name: token_info
title: Token info
